title: Audit V18 Notas/fecha and login static contract before browser verification
mission: Statically verify the completed V18 Notas/fecha bridge and generic login capability boundary before spending a representative-browser slot. Inspect the exact V18 source plus the verified native-notes/date and login implementation returns; prove synthetic Clase 01-04 / Fecha por definir placeholders are absent, login remains visibly disabled/capability-honest, and Version anterior is wired. Run bounded repository regressions when available; do not claim interactive browser behavior from static evidence.
definition_of_done: Inspect gh-pages:pages/study-library/study-v18.js and the two completed implementation returns named by the browser-verification job.
Verify from exact source that Notas/fecha uses real legacy session/date data or honest loading/error/empty states and does not synthesize Clase 01-04 or Fecha por definir placeholders.
Verify the generic login control remains visibly disabled/capability-honest and is not silently aliased to Blackboard or another product login.
Verify Version anterior is wired to a real target and no obvious static contract defect prevents use.
Run bounded repository-local regressions when the runtime permits; patch only bounded repository-local defects if found, otherwise record STATIC_CONTRACT_OK.
Leave representative_javascript_browser as the explicit remaining browser-only boundary; do not infer Human Accepted.
No Current, Human Accepted or Served promotion.
